evidenceClass: Public-web discoverability + source-page feature inspection, not geo-verified Google SERP top10 or rankings
releasePolicy: All 13 remain noindex until domain, manual editorial, SERP and technical gates are passed

candidates.differentiator: Number-to-label decision mapping with a downloadable record
candidates.weakness: Competitors already explain assigning labels to 1 and 2; intent often wants one immediate digit, not a second workflow.
candidates.action: Put a one-tap 1/2 result and explicit current mapped label together above the fold; test intent against direct-answer results.

candidates.differentiator: Up to 8 team names receive unique numbered stations and an exported assignment list
candidates.weakness: Primary generic query may favor instant dice-style pickers; station assignment is a secondary classroom intent.
candidates.action: Keep simple eight-number draw first, then offer station assignment; verify US query clusters and teacher task uptake.

candidates.differentiator: Both immediate 1–10 draw and complete repeat-free 10-number order
candidates.weakness: Quick pick and elimination already exist on competitor pages; direct-answer SERP can satisfy query without a page click.
candidates.action: Measure click intent and distinguish shuffle/full-order use case, preferably with visible copy-ready results and comparison UI.

candidates.differentiator: Validated participant-name list with a unique presentation order
candidates.weakness: Most generic 1–15 queries ask for a digit or wheel. Roster entry changes the job to a named randomizer.
candidates.action: Keep instant 1–15 selection primary; clarify the named presentation-order tool as optional; validate whether roster-focused long tails exist.

candidates.differentiator: Absent-number exclusion plus one-by-one call progression and full CSV attendance order
candidates.weakness: Existing educational tools support absence markings and elimination; our whole-order export and stepwise call are potentially useful, not yet proven superior.
candidates.action: Make the classroom task discoverable immediately, label absent/current/remaining clearly, and validate teacher usability against competing class tools.

candidates.differentiator: Browser-secure, without-replacement sample plus CSV and exclusions
candidates.weakness: TNAADO supports up to 10,000 results per batch (per public description), compared with our 100 limit. Other sites already provide immediate draw and no-repeat history.
candidates.action: Optimize large-batch algorithm and accessible copy/export workflow; evaluate whether 100-count cap can be increased without large memory/performance impact; keep noindex.

candidates.differentiator: Alphabet, vowels/consonants, exclusions, group prompt and 60-second timer
candidates.weakness: Competing letter tools already offer category game, timer, elimination, uppercase/lowercase and rich teaching guidance. Our classroom prompt is currently less comprehensive.
candidates.action: Offer multi-category classroom rounds and an accessible score sheet; support phonics cases beyond single-letter prompt after usability validation.

candidates.differentiator: Optional question, local tally and a three-draw summary
candidates.weakness: Question input, Yes/No/Maybe, tally and best-of-three are already present in established competitors. Hard to claim unique value.
candidates.action: Fix round semantics so two-answer best-of-three stops at the second identical result, distinguish three-way plurality from binary majority, and improve visual odds.

candidates.weakness: Weekly scheduling text without a true weekday mapping workflow is too close to neighboring range templates.
candidates.action: Do not independently index until weekday-to-task schedule or concrete seven-way use case exists.

candidates.weakness: Large visual wheel simplifies segments and lacks evidence of distinct search intent beyond the parent number generator.
candidates.action: Document 50-number visual sampling semantics and validate demand before a separate index decision.

candidates.weakness: Small known cluster and a tool identical to parent with different max value.
candidates.action: Prefer existing generic picker; keep page noindex unless real demand and new workflow prove incremental value.

candidates.weakness: Little evidence of independent SEO intent; candidate is template-only.
candidates.action: Continue offering the utility via tool directory; hold off standalone SEO indexing.

candidates.differentiator: Five curated short category lists plus custom entries
candidates.weakness: Prebuilt collections remain small and lack a grading/length/learning-objective filter.
candidates.action: Build quality-reviewed broader collections or specific educational workflow before re-review.
